gpuBlackMarket.threshold: Premium falling = sanctions leaking; Premium rising = bottleneck tightening
gpuBlackMarket.threshold_zh: 溢价下降=制裁在漏；溢价上升=瓶颈收紧
gpuBlackMarket.note: Nvidia B200 racks now fetching 50% premiums on China black market (Crypto Briefing, Jun 24). China plans $295B AI grid locking out Nvidia (abhs.in, Jun 24). Alibaba shipped 560K Zhenwu AI chips. Nvidia pitches Arm-based Vera CPUs to Chinese clients targeting Aug shipments (MLQ.ai, Jun 14). H100 premium stable at 2-3x, but market attention shifting to B200 pricing. Updated 2026-06-28
gpuBlackMarket.note_zh: Nvidia B200机柜在中国黑市溢价50%（6月24日）。中国计划$2950亿AI算力网排挤Nvidia（6月24日）。阿里巴巴交付56万颗真武芯片。Nvidia向中国客户推Arm架构Vera CPU（MLQ.ai，6月14日）。H100溢价稳定2-3倍，但市场关注转向B200定价。更新于 2026-06-28

aiInferenceVolume.unit: China LLM API inference market size

aiInferenceVolume.threshold: Inference revenue growing faster than training = real economy adoption, not just model-building
aiInferenceVolume.threshold_zh: 推理收入增速超训练=真实经济渗透，不只是建模型
aiInferenceVolume.note: Inference-to-training revenue ratio is the key metric. China inference share rising faster than US at same stage.
aiInferenceVolume.note_zh: 推理/训练收入比是关键指标。中国推理占比增速超过美国同阶段。
